ruleDefinitions.name: User Added To Admin Group Via Dscl
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects attempts to create and add an account to the admin group via "dscl"

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/dscl$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-append\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/Groups\\/admin\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ GroupMembership\\ .*")))
